name: FAOSTAT: Crops and livestock products (QCL), potatoes, India
organization: Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO)
dataset: Bulk file Production_Crops_Livestock_E_All_Data_(Normalized).zip: Area harvested (5312), Yield (5412), Production (5510) for Potatoes (item 116), India (area code 100), 1961 to latest year
geography: India: national level only (no state or district granularity)
units: Area: ha; yield: kg/ha; production: tonnes
licence: CC BY 4.0 with FAO additional terms of use (https://www.fao.org/contact-us/terms/db-terms-of-use/en/)
usageNotes: Historical benchmark only, never real-time. The FAOSTAT JSON API needs an authorisation token, so the public bulk file is used instead; the 34 MB zip is streamed and only the India potato rows are kept (the zip's SHA-256 is recorded).
integrationNote: Verified live on 2026-10-07: bulk file reachable (HTTP 200, 33.9 MB); India potato rows found for 1961 to 2024.
